summary: KE Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns for April 27–30, 2026, disclosing a series of share repurchases. From April 1–24, 2026, the company bought back approximately 18.6 million shares at prices ranging from $4.92 to $5.50 each, with the repurchased shares not yet canceled as of April 24. The board has not issued a formal recommendation; no advisor is named. The repurchases are ongoing, reported daily under HK Listing Rules. Watch for further buyback authorization updates or cancellation effects on share count.
